checks.description: The lesson correctly explains RAG and does not confuse retrieval with model training.
The lesson uses simple English suitable for a 12th-grade graduate with no AI background.
Technical terms are explained in simple language before or when they are first used.
The lesson includes a concrete example showing how RAG answers a question using retrieved information.
The lesson explains what RAG is, why it matters, and how it works, including retrieval, context, and generation.
The lesson follows a logical teaching order, with concepts introduced before they are used.
